name: brewtrend
title: Homebrew install trends
description: Trending Homebrew packages ranked by recent install volume and 30-day-vs-90-day momentum. Produced by the brewtrend arcform pipeline from formulae.brew.sh analytics.

resources.name: ranking
resources.description: One row per ranked package. Lower rank = stronger combined trend + volume signal.

fields.name: trend_index
fields.description: Momentum: mean daily installs over the prior 60 days relative to the last 30 days. 0 below the trend threshold.

x-arcform-note: This descriptor describes the pipeline's OUTPUT data (decision 0017). It is not the runnable artifact — `arc run` executes arcform.yaml.
